title: Close, Dock/tray reopen, and explicit quit

requirements.initial: The app window and a Workspace task are active.
requirements.action: Close the window and reopen via Dock/tray.
requirements.expected: The same window/Session returns and the owned backend keeps running.

evidence.assertion: hides an ordinary close without destroying the window or quitting the app
restores the hidden window when the macOS Dock activates the app
evidence.scope: Synthetic activate event; no real Dock.

evidence.assertion: uses the same restoration path for the tray
evidence.scope: Direct restoration helper; no native tray click.

requirements.gap: Real macOS and Windows close/reopen with an active Session must be accepted separately.

requirements.action: Close or activate the window while resources are being released.
requirements.expected: The app exits cleanly and activation cannot reopen it.

evidence.assertion: allows the window to close when explicit app shutdown has started
evidence.scope: Controlled quitting flag; no child-process cleanup.

evidence.assertion: does not reopen a window during shutdown

requirements.gap: Owned PTY/service cleanup after native menu Quit and the close/quit race lack mapped native evidence.
